title: Fluid Displacement
description: A surreal, dreamlike landscape rendered with fluid, organic distortion effects. The scene depicts a cityscape with tall buildings emerging from or submerged within thick, billowing clouds or fog. The dominant visual effect is a wavy, undulating displacement that creates a liquid, ink-like quality throughout the entire composition. The sky features a warm, glowing sunset with a bright yellow sun positioned in the upper right, casting golden and orange hues across the scene. The clouds have smooth, flowing contours with wave-like patterns that suggest the DisplacementMap effect is actively warping the underlying ImageTexture. The buildings appear semi-transparent and ethereal, with their forms softened and distorted by the displacement effect. The overall atmosphere is ethereal and contemplative, with a strong sense of movement and fluidity despite the static nature of the architecture. The color palette transitions from warm peachy-orange tones in the sky to cooler blue-gray tones in the clouds and building silhouettes. The InkFlow component (though set to invisible) is driving the displacement patterns, creating organic, flowing distortions with a decay of 0.5 and momentum of 0.6, resulting in smooth, wave-like undulations throughout the composition.
